title: Animated screenshot sequences and micro-callout pack for quickstart changelog
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Produce an image and short-motion asset pack to accompany the upcoming quickstart/changelog blog post and release notes. Deliver a set of static before/after UI artboards, a 6-8 second animated screenshot sequence (loopable MP4 + GIF fallback) that highlights the new onboarding flow and two micro-callout overlays for feature-level narration. Assets should be export-ready for marketing, docs, and the console changelog slot. Keep assets screen-resolution-aware (desktop and tablet frames) and include light/dark variants.
acceptance_criteria: One desktop and one tablet static before/after PNG set (with annotated callouts) exported at 2x and 1x
One loopable animated screenshot MP4 (6-8s) + optimized GIF fallback under 3MB that highlights: new quickstart stepper, improved API key UX, and rollout toggle
Two micro-callout overlay PNGs with copy tokens (60-90 chars) and arrow/vector pointers, separate light/dark variants
Figma file with named frames, componentized callout overlays, and an export-ready spec for marketing and docs
Design handoff notes in Confluence with required alt text, recommended captions, and suggested A/B copy for the blog hero
design_notes: Motion should be subtle: prefer crossfades + micro-pan over aggressive zooms to preserve token/console legibility.
When showing KV cache indicators, use simplified iconography to avoid model internals exposure in marketing content.
Avoid showing real user data in screenshots; use seeded example projects from the 'demo-org' fixture.
Callouts limited to two per frame to keep image weight low and maintain visual hierarchy for blog hero.
Export settings: MP4 H.264 baseline profile; GIF via ffmpeg palettegen for color fidelity; mobile-first sizing considerations.
